arithmetic: Exact 32-bit Shoup multiplication for 31-bit NTT fields
proof: q=floor(b*2^32/p), t=floor(a*q/2^32). For 0<=a,b<p<2^31, 0<=a*b-t*p<2*p<2^32; one conditional subtraction yields a*b mod p. Compact roots are converted from r*R to r, so multiplying an R-domain operand preserves that domain.
